notes.title: Ending Free-To-Play
notes.notes: Many of you, including ourselves do not like micro-transactions. We attempted to keep the game "Free" with the option of purchasable cosmetics. Unfortunately abuse of the micro-transaction model by many developers (especially mobile games) has led to players giving all micro-transactions a wide-birth. We feel seeking funding through this measure is doing more harm than good. We believe if players like the content we create, then they will show support by buying the game. Thank you everyone for your continued support in the our development of great games! We hope to continue creating games for our growing community!

notes.title: Two new loadouts added!!
notes.notes:
Two new loadouts added this update:

The Snatcher; An AI's worst nightmare, use this loadout to take over unsuspecting AI and use their strengths as your strengths!

The Mothership; Ever want to command an army of minions that will just throw themselves at your enemies? Us too! With this loadout you can have units spawn next to you  and follow you to battle!

These two loadouts will be free to use during their testing grace period.
